methodology: Expand10 identity growth. Prefer Arturia product-list gaps (Play editions + V/FX Collection 11/6 bundles) + Cherry full list (0 net, already dense) + new soundset-heavy mfrs UJAM / Orchestral Tools / Cinesamples / 8Dio + Output Arcade Lines as soundset + Audiomodern fill + Surreal Machines + Puremagnetik devices + FOSS Helm/Cardinal. Kilohearts snapins already dense (0 net). Dedup by manufacturer norm + id. No invented versions. No git clone.
